params.name: action
params.description: Standard action name (or a Standard Action theme constant), optionally with a parameter pattern such as "gotoPage?value=2".

params.name: target
params.description: Form context in which to execute the action.

sentinelValues.meaning: ak current form (default if omitted): the form where the action was invoked; execution is synchronous, in the current cycle.
ak main form: the frontmost document/dialog form of the process; execution is asynchronous, in the next cycle after the calling form object method returns.

overloads.semanticRole: Triggers a standard 4D action programmatically, in either the current form (synchronously) or the process's main form (asynchronously).

constraints: Standard edit actions (Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all, Clear, Undo/Redo) ignore target if passed; they always execute synchronously in the context of the currently focused editable object.
Does not generate an error if the requested action is unavailable in the current context; use Action info beforehand to validate that the action applies.
